parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be deprecated.

parameters.name: ConsumptionTimestamp
parameters.description: The consumption checkpoint in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SubscriptionInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the **DescribeSubscriptionInstances** operation to query the instance ID.
